description.zh: 直播流所属应用名称。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看AppName。
description.en: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. You can view the AppName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

description.zh: 封禁方式，blacklist：黑名单，whitelist：白名单。
description.en:
The blocking mode. Valid values:
- blacklist: blacklist.
- whitelist: whitelist.

description.zh: 封禁区域，如CN，AS多个以逗号隔开。
description.en: The blocked regions, such as CN and AS. Separate multiple regions with commas (,).

description.zh: 封禁结束时间，UTC格式，不填默认封禁7天。
description.en: The end time of the blocking period in UTC. If this parameter is not specified, the blocking lasts for 7 days by default.

description.zh: 直播流名称。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看StreamName。
description.en: The name of the live stream. You can view the StreamName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

descriptions.zh:
一个域名最多支持配置200条直播流区域封禁规则，直播流区域封禁中如果出现重复的AppName和StreamName对应的规则，则以最近的更新时间生效。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can configure up to 200 live stream area blocking rules for a domain name. If duplicate rules with the same AppName and StreamName exist in the live stream area blocking rules, the most recently updated rule takes effect.
### QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 50 calls per second. If this limit is exceeded, the API invocations are throttled, which may affect your business. Invoke this operation appropriately.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live set-live-stream-block --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --block-type blacklist --location-list CN --release-time 2016-06-29T19:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live SetLiveStreamBlock --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName liveStream0000 --DomainName 'example.com' --BlockType blacklist --ReleaseTime '2016-06-29T19:00:00Z' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --LocationList CN --AppName liveApp0000
